verdict: Batched share telemetry with a beacon on hide.

findings.title: Do not send guests' email and name to Microsoft Clarity
findings.scenario: A signed-in guest opens a share on a deployment with CLARITY_PROJECT_ID set (it is set in wrangler.jsonc).
findings.consequence: installTracking calls clarity('identify', viewer.email, ..., viewer.name), attaching the guest's Google email and display name to their Clarity session recordings at a third party, which the privacy policy does not mention.
findings.fix: Identify with an opaque id (trackSessionId or a hash of the email) and drop the friendly-name argument; if the email is needed, keep it in the app's own People data only.
